description: Search bills, legislators, committees, and events across all 50 US states, DC, and 5 US territories.
name: io.github.cyanheads/openstates-mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: Open States API key from open.pluralpolicy.com. Required to make any API requests.
environmentVariables.name: OPENSTATES_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Maximum upstream Open States requests per rolling 24 hours. Rejects before the request is issued once spent. Defaults to the v3 free-tier daily cap.
environmentVariables.name: OPENSTATES_DAILY_REQUEST_BUDGET

environmentVariables.description: Per-attempt upstream request deadline in milliseconds (minimum 1000). Expiry is non-retryable. Open States answers a scoped query in under a second to ~57s and its gateway gives up near 60s.
environmentVariables.name: OPENSTATES_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Wall-clock ceiling in milliseconds for one call across every retry attempt and the backoff between them. Bounds a slow upstream that keeps failing retryably. Must be at least OPENSTATES_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS; startup rejects a lower value.
environmentVariables.name: OPENSTATES_TOTAL_REQUEST_BUDGET_MS

environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
